name: start_cia_timer_interrupt
description: Saves the current timer state, then programs the CIA-A timer control and interrupt registers and sets the timer interrupt enable bit when a status flag is set. Interrupt enable is written through the custom interrupt enable register.

name: restore_cia_timer_state
description: When a stored flag is negative, writes the previously saved values back into the CIA-A timer control registers and sets the timer interrupt enable bit again.

name: poll_status_bit_sequence
description: When a flag bit is set, writes a fixed four-value sequence to working variables, waits until a status bit is set, then clears a bit in the same variable. The routine finishes by storing a constant.

name: handle_keyboard_serial_handshake
description: When a flag bit is set, writes a fixed four-value sequence, waits until a status bit is set and clears a bit, while the facts show the keyboard serial register and timer registers in use. It then stores a constant.

name: clear_state_after_helper
description: Calls an unnamed routine and then zeroes one state word. Two callers use it.

name: decrement_state_and_reload
description: Subtracts two from a state word, and if the previous value was below two, reloads it from a value derived from another variable. It then calls an unnamed routine.

name: check_bounds_no_effect
description: Compares two register arguments against fixed limits, but both branches return without changing anything, so the routine has no effect.

name: advance_channel_sequence_state
description: Counts down a per-channel timer, and when it expires reloads several per-channel fields from a table. It then steps a byte stream, calls helper routines, and returns an updated count.

name: update_channel_sequence_state
description: Variant of the channel sequence routine that performs the same countdown, reload and byte-stream steps but returns no value.

name: blend_masked_bitplane_rows
description: Merges a source block into a destination across four bitplanes, using a mask chosen from a table by one argument. It processes eight rows with a 40-byte row stride per plane.

name: fill_block_with_ones
description: Writes the value 255 to 1000 consecutive bytes starting at a fixed location, looping until the counter wraps.

name: call_unresolved_helper
description: Decompiler output is unavailable, so only the facts are known: an 8-instruction routine that calls one unnamed routine and is executed in the reference run.

name: forward_to_single_helper
description: Decompiler output is unavailable; the routine is 3 instructions long, is called by a small return stub, and calls one unnamed routine.

name: call_helpers_using_text
description: Decompiler output is unavailable; the routine is 24 instructions long, refers to a short text string, and calls four unnamed routines.

name: read_data_in_sectors
description: Splits a requested byte count into 512-byte blocks and calls an unnamed routine for each block. A partial final block is read into a 512-byte stack buffer and then copied to the destination.

name: map_status_code_wrapper
description: Calls an unnamed routine and converts return code 28 to 1 and return code 29 to 2, leaving other codes unchanged.

name: map_status_code_wrapper
description: Calls an unnamed routine and converts return code 28 to 1 and return code 29 to 2, leaving other codes unchanged. Same logic as its neighbours.

name: map_status_code_wrapper
description: Calls an unnamed routine and converts return code 28 to 1 and return code 29 to 2, leaving other codes unchanged. Same logic as its neighbours.

name: map_status_code_via_jump
description: Calls an unnamed routine through a jump-table entry and converts return code 28 to 1 and return code 29 to 2, leaving other codes unchanged.

name: handle_vertical_blank_interrupt
description: Increments two counters, calls a stored handler when one of them is nonzero, and copies the vertical blank request bit from the interrupt request register into a variable.

name: relay_call_to_routine
description: Calls a single unnamed routine and returns, passing control straight through. Called from one place.

name: relay_call_to_routine
description: Calls a single unnamed routine and returns, passing control straight through. Called from one place.

name: call_stored_pointer_routine
description: Calls the routine whose address is held in a global variable. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is shown as a call.

name: halt_in_infinite_loop
description: Does nothing but loop forever. The facts list the background colour register as touched, but the body shows no write to it.

name: return_immediately
description: Contains only a return instruction and does nothing. It is executed on the reference run.

name: init_display_and_callbacks
description: Calls two entries from a supplied table, sets a few global words to fixed values and stores a callback address. It then calls further entries from the same table, with the display DMA control register in the facts.

name: chain_into_loaded_entry
description: Calls one entry from a stored table, then transfers control to the start address held in a global. The jump table could not be recovered, so the final jump appears as an indirect call.

name: chain_into_loaded_entry
description: Same sequence as its neighbour: calls an entry from a stored table and then transfers control to a stored start address. It was decoded from a gap in the file, so it may not be reached.

name: copy_selected_patch_block
description: After a call, if the returned code is 184, copies a 92-word block chosen by a selector from one of three tables into global memory and calls another table entry. Some branches first write a no-op instruction pair and a branch opcode.

name: detect_version_marker
description: Calls an entry, then compares an eight-byte stack value against two text markers. A match on the first marker sets a selector to 2 and a match on the second sets it to 3.

name: call_entry_when_nonzero
description: When a flag is clear and the word argument is nonzero, calls an entry from the stored table. Otherwise it returns its register argument unchanged.

name: format_digit_character
description: Maps 0 to a form-feed code, 10 to the character zero with a newline return, and other values to their digit character, storing that character in a global.

name: store_digit_character
description: Stores the value plus the character zero into a global variable and returns the original value.

name: call_entry_when_nonzero
description: Same test as its neighbour: when a flag is clear and the word argument is nonzero, calls an entry from the stored table.

name: bootstrap_entry_and_launch
description: Runs as the boot block entry. It calls several library entries, checks a returned pointer, copies a block of data into memory and calls a routine, then jumps to the loaded start address. The decompiled tail contains undecodable data, so only the start is reliable.

name: bootstrap_probe_and_launch
description: Calls several exec library entries, performs a disk request, copies a block of setup words into memory and transfers control to the loaded start address. The decompiled tail contains undecodable data.

name: enable_dma_then_launch
description: Writes a DMA control value, sets a pointer to a memory location, waits in a loop until a returned flag clears, and then jumps to the start address. The facts show the DMA control register is used.

name: read_sectors_by_track
description: Converts a linear sector number into a track and sector using eleven sectors per track, then reads the requested count one track segment at a time. It returns the final status code.

name: read_track_with_retries
description: Makes up to four attempts to read a disk track: each attempt clears per-attempt state, looks for the sector sync pattern and writes the marker words into the track buffer. It returns a status code, and the disk status register is checked on each attempt.

name: start_disk_dma_transfer
description: Sets the disk DMA pointer and length registers for a track transfer, choosing the length from an argument, and retries while a status bit remains set. It then returns a status code.

name: write_sync_pattern_per_sector
description: Writes the double sync word into a sector area eleven times, advancing to the next sector slot on each pass, with calls to other routines between writes.

name: verify_sector_with_retries
description: Retries up to ten times, checking a status flag and comparing a sector value with an expected value. On a match it stores a value and returns success, otherwise it returns a failure code.

name: scan_track_sector_headers
description: Walks through up to eleven sector slots on a track, checking the disk status bit and comparing track or sector values. It returns a status code describing success or one of several failure cases.

name: return_immediately
description: Empty routine that only returns and has no effect.

name: set_sector_bit_and_count
description: Sets one bit, chosen by a bit index, in a 16-bit word at a fixed offset from a base pointer, then increments a 16-bit counter stored just before it.

name: clear_sector_slots
description: Writes zero into the first longword of ten sector-sized slots, stepping through memory in fixed strides of 1088 bytes.

name: pack_long_into_word_pair
description: Takes a 32-bit value from an unnamed routine and returns a repacked value with its low 16 bits in one half and its top byte in the other half.

name: decode_interleaved_long_bits
description: Reads two consecutive longwords and combines their alternate bits, shifting one set left by one, in the same way as the other disk-decoding routines in this file.

name: decode_then_pass_value
description: Calls an unnamed routine to obtain a decoded value, then passes that value on to a second unnamed routine.

name: checksum_ten_longwords
description: XORs ten consecutive longwords starting eight bytes past a base pointer and keeps only the alternate bits of the result. The masked value serves as a checksum over that block.

name: checksum_longwords_by_count
description: XORs a count-determined number of longwords from an input pointer and returns the result masked to alternate bits. The count comes from a word argument divided by four.

name: fill_block_with_pattern
description: Fills a block with an alternating bit pattern, working backwards from its end. The block is 256 longwords or 3248 longwords depending on a flag in a structure.

name: interleave_bit_streams
description: Combines 128 longwords from two source blocks into one destination block, taking alternate bits from each source.

name: loop_clear_and_mix_words
description: Runs a loop whose count comes from the first argument, calling a byte-clearing routine and a word-mixing routine on each pass, then calls both once more. It returns its two register arguments unchanged.

name: update_byte_flag_after_calls
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then updates a byte: if the byte before it has bit 0 clear, the top bit is set unless bit 6 is already set; otherwise the top bit is cleared. The byte is written back only when it changes.

name: update_top_bit_by_flag
description: Reads a byte and tests bit 0 of the byte before it. If that bit is clear, sets the top bit unless bit 6 is already set, and if it is set, clears the top bit, then writes the byte back.

name: set_disk_read_registers
description: Writes the disk sync word, the disk pointer and the length register for a read, with the length taken from an argument and its top bit set to start the transfer. It also writes the ADKCON and DMACON control registers.

name: wait_for_disk_block_done
description: Polls a status bit, calling an unnamed routine on each pass, until the bit is set. It then writes two fixed values to globals and returns zero.

name: write_control_word_if_negative
description: Writes a fixed control value, then, when a stored signed value is negative, writes a byte that sets a single bit chosen from a stored index.

name: set_ciab_port_bit
description: Writes the CIA-B port B output with one bit set, chosen by a stored index plus three, and leaves the other bits as they were.

name: wait_ciab_flag_until_result
description: Sets a control global to all ones, then repeats an unnamed routine while waiting for a status bit to clear, until that routine returns one. It returns zero.

name: update_table_entry_with_steps
description: Looks up a word in a table by a stored index, compares the 15-bit fields of two inputs, repeats an unnamed routine for the difference, then stores the new value back into the table.

name: clear_table_entry_when_ready
description: Waits for up to 86 passes while a status bit is set, calling an unnamed routine each time. When the bit clears it zeroes the table entry chosen by a stored index and returns zero; otherwise it returns 30.

name: set_ciab_port_and_wait
description: Updates the CIA-B port B output using a flag from an argument, sets its bit 0, then repeats an unnamed routine until it returns one. It returns zero.

name: store_routine_result_to_port
description: Stores the value returned by an unnamed routine into the CIA-B port B output.

name: mask_byte_for_port_update
description: Builds an output byte from a global value by clearing a bit chosen from a stored index, and clears a further bit when a table flag is set. It returns the input high word, the new byte and the low word combined.

name: wait_until_timer_result_one
description: Repeats an unnamed routine until it returns one, and between calls waits while bit 0 of a global is set. It returns zero.

name: start_ciab_timer_conditionally
description: When bit 0 of a global is clear and the argument is not one, writes three fixed values to the CIA-B timer control registers.

name: set_ciab_timer_values
description: Writes three fixed values to the CIA-B timer control and timer count registers in sequence.

name: copy_interleaved_block_rows
description: Copies 120 rows in fixed-size groups of longwords from a source area to a destination area at a fixed offset, using several spacings within each row.

name: call_routine_four_times
description: Calls an unnamed routine four times in succession and returns its two register arguments unchanged.

name: update_countdown_record

name: write_fixed_fields_on_flag

name: copy_record_fields_on_flag

name: decrement_countdown_then_call
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then when a flag is nonzero decrements a countdown byte and calls an unnamed routine once it reaches zero. It returns the stored value.

name: tick_countdown_and_call

name: advance_three_phase_state

name: initialise_audio_channels
description: Clears the volume, period and length registers of the four audio channels, copies a table of parameter words into memory, and sets the sample pointers and volumes for each channel. It then writes DMA control bits.

name: reset_channel_record_state

description: Copies a counted block of longwords to a destination described in a structure, then zeroes any remaining bytes up to the stated size. It returns 1. It was decoded from a gap in the file.

name: zero_fill_longword_block
description: Writes zero into a counted run of longwords at the destination stored in a structure, then returns 1.

name: add_values_at_offsets
description: Walks a list of records, each giving a count and a list of offsets, and adds a stored value to the word at each offset from a base pointer. It returns 1.

name: return_zero_code
description: Returns the constant 0 and does nothing else. It was decoded from a gap in the file.

name: return_immediately
description: Contains only a return and does nothing. It is executed on the reference run.

name: return_success_code
description: Returns the constant 1 and does nothing else. It was decoded from a gap in the file.

name: return_zero_code
description: The decompiled body only returns zero, though the routine is 45 instructions long, so the remaining code was not recovered. It is not reached in the reference run.

name: relay_call_to_routine

name: setup_copper_and_clear_colours

name: build_stepped_word_list
description: Builds a list of eight-byte entries, storing the low and high words of a value that increases by a fixed step on each pass.

name: setup_display_and_wait_raster
description: Resets four global values, clears the 32 colour registers, calls a routine that waits for a raster line, then loops forever. The facts list the background colour, display control and beam position registers.

name: wait_for_flag_then_halt
description: Waits until a global variable reaches a specific value, then loops forever. The facts list a call to a raster-line wait routine and the copper pointer register.

name: wait_flag_then_set_value
description: Calls a raster-line wait and three unnamed routines in a loop until a global variable is nonzero, then writes a fixed value to a global variable.

name: copy_sixteen_longwords
description: Copies 16 longwords from one fixed address to another fixed address.

name: wait_until_flag_set
description: Loops until a global variable becomes nonzero, then returns.

name: split_words_into_nibble_table
description: Clears 48 longwords, then splits each input word into three 4-bit components, computes a scaled value for each by dividing by fifteen, and stores them in a table. It sets a global to two.

name: update_nibble_table_entries
description: Compares 4-bit fields of table entries against stored values, adds a step to each mismatched entry, and sets a flag when all entries have been processed. It calls an empty routine.

name: copy_masked_nibbles_into_table
description: Clears 48 longwords, then copies the 4-bit fields of each input word into a table without scaling. It sets a global to three.

name: update_nibble_table_by_subtraction
description: Subtracts a step from each non-zero 4-bit component in a table, counting how many components changed. When none change it sets a global flag, and it calls an empty routine.

name: setup_bitstream_decoder
description: Fills a decoder state block with buffer pointers and limits, then repeatedly calls two unnamed routines and advances an output pointer until the requested size is produced. It returns zero.

name: advance_decoder_window
description: Sets a state field from one of two input counters, then advances both counters by a fixed window size. It returns zero.

name: set_decoder_table_limits
description: Writes two fixed 16-bit limit values into a decoder state block, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: fill_decoder_lookup_table
description: Fills a 16-bit lookup table with two runs: 128 pairs of ascending values starting from a negative base, then 256 entries counting down.

name: build_huffman_code_table
description: Counts the code lengths for up to sixteen bit lengths, computes cumulative code offsets, and fills the lookup table with the assigned codes. It returns an error code when the lengths do not fit.

name: decode_bitstream_symbols
description: Reads bits from an input stream and decodes each symbol through lookup tables into output bytes. It calls three unnamed routines, including one that refills the input buffer, and the decompiled output is truncated.

name: decode_nine_bit_symbol_stream
description: A larger variant of the bitstream decoder that reads nine-bit symbols, decodes them through lookup tables, and writes bytes to memory. It calls two unnamed routines when the input buffer needs refilling.

name: xor_chain_rotate_bytes
description: Transforms 32 bytes by rotating each one left by two bits and XORing it with the previously written value, starting from 255. The results are written to a second buffer.

name: decode_table_driven_block
description: Main table-driven decoding routine: sets up a state structure, reads each input value through lookup tables and calls four unnamed routines. It returns a status code, and the decompiled output is truncated.

name: return_status_or_error_three
description: Calls an unnamed routine; when its result is negative it stores a saved value and returns the error code three, otherwise it returns its register arguments unchanged.

name: call_stored_pointer_return_value
description: Calls a routine whose address is held in a state structure and returns a word stored in that structure.

name: convert_chunky_pixels_to_planar
description: Converts groups of bytes into bit-planar form using mask-and-shift steps, writing the rearranged values through output pointers.

name: forward_execution_to_routine
description: Decompiler output is unavailable. The routine is one instruction long, is executed on the reference run and calls one unnamed routine.

name: wait_flag_then_set_value
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then repeats three unnamed routine calls while a global value is zero, and finally stores an address into a global variable.

name: setup_copper_and_clear_colours
description: Calls two unnamed routines, writes the copper list pointer and two DMA-related words, clears the 32 colour registers, then loops waiting on a global variable. It does not return.

name: build_stepped_word_list
description: Writes 16 pairs of words into a structure, storing the low and high words of a value that increases by a fixed step on each pass.

name: wait_for_flag_then_halt
description: Waits until a global variable reaches a specific value, then loops forever.

name: copy_block_onto_itself
description: Copies 16 longwords from a memory block to the same address, so the memory contents are left unchanged.

description: Loops until a global variable becomes nonzero, then returns.
